<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Geopolitical and Energy Jitters:</strong> Global markets are reeling as Brent crude prices top $100 per barrel and US-Iran tensions escalate, driving US stocks down over 2% and triggering a broad sell-off across Asian indices like the Nikkei and Kospi.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
